title: Blue to lime / Smooth
description: Blue-to-lime color transition with an almost smooth finish, to compare directly with the fine and coarse grain versions.
prompt: Create a single standalone high-resolution landscape 16:9 graphic background, ideally 2560×1440 or larger. This is a flat editorial color-gradient background for Recoup, meant to sit behind typography added later. The canvas must have no text whatsoever, no letters, no logo, no symbols, no objects, no scenery, no clouds, no horizons, no glass, no glassmorphism, no embossing, no folded materials, no shadows, no dimensional surfaces, no light beams, no UI, no frame, no border, no contact sheet. Use beautiful strong clean luminosity and very soft broad transitions between colors, without banding. Keep most of the upper-left and central image usable behind type. Full bleed. Composition for a controlled gradient comparison: rich sky blue #007EBD covers the upper-left and most of the top/center, shifting softly through bright blue #168DDD and clear cyan across the center-right. A broad luminous citron-lime #D6FF62 glow enters from the lower-right edge and sweeps gently along the bottom, with soft pale aqua #C2EDFF transition between blue and lime. About two thirds blue and one third pale aqua/lime. Flat color atmosphere with no identifiable forms. Surface: almost perfectly smooth color, no visible grain, no visible texture. The reference supplies only the broad blue-to-lime arrangement and color family. Remove its grain completely. Do not add any photographic texture.
